skill.displayName: AI Action Figure Generator – Turn Your Photo into a Custom Toy Version – API-powered
skill.summary: AI action figure generator — turn a photo or character into a collectible action figure display

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Action Figure Generators OpenAPI Skill.

- Generate collectible action figure images from character photos or descriptions.
- Supports HTTPS access and requires a WeShop API key for authentication.
- API endpoints: start a run, poll run status, upload images.
- Customizable input: upload an image, add text description, and specify number of figures to generate (1-16).
- Secure: API key should only be used with the official WeShop OpenAPI endpoint.
